d: Deep-time cosmic hard science fiction sagas by Stephen Baxter, spanning the Xeelee Sequence and the colonization of Proxima Centauri.

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: Harsh tidally-locked world orbiting Proxima Centauri settled by human penal colonists who discover the alien Roman-era Hatch artifact.

sagittarius-a-star.x: Cosmic-string portal megastructure constructed by the Xeelee near the galactic supermassive black hole to escape into a new universe.

jupiter.x: Orbital anchor for the relativistic wormhole interface linking the Sol system to distant star systems across the Coalition expansion.

mercury.x: Expedition site where humans uncover the solar system counterpart to the Proxima Hatch wormhole doorway.

b.s: Sweeping hard SF works from Stephen Baxter encompassing the multi-billion-year war between the baryonic Xeelee and dark-matter Photino Birds, along with the harsh colonization of Per Ardua in Proxima.
